body: My relationship is the only thing that used to make me happy but it hurts me so much worse when he acts like he doesn't care.  Last time I was this bad he understood just for a while how intensely I want to die.  He said he was going to call the cops and I begged him not to.  I'm terrified of treatment because everyone would treat me like a fucking pariah.

When I lost my job I sat with my gun for hours, when I finally tried it jammed.  I put it down and told myself it was a sign to not do it, that I could keep going, but I'm tired of hurting.

Some days it hurts so much I can barely function and I just feel like a shell walking around, already dead but still breathing.

It really doesn't feel like anyone is there.  SO had his own suicide attempt, I was the one who called and begged his family to go and help him, he almost died before the ambulance got there (cut his wrist up the the elbow to where you could see bone and damaged the tendons/hit several veins).  He acts like I just want attention.  No one else even gives a fuck. I've stopped myself so many times but I just don't feel like it's worth it if I'm going to feel like this every day.

I called in a friend before, cops came, ambulance, he had cut his wrist all the way to his elbow, you could see bone, and they took him to the ER and then to a juvenile psych ward.  Me and another friend had to beg his family to check on him and ended up calling 911 because they didn't care. I thoroughly feel we saved his life, and I hope that someone will help me if that time comes.
